name: tool-leira-job-fit-tailor-s56adxsn
description: Score a CV against one job ad: evidence-based fit grade, honest gaps, a tailored CV that never invents experience, a cover note, and interview preparation.

tools.name: analyze_job_fit
tools.description: Analyze how well a CV fits one job ad. The CV can be pasted text or an uploaded file (PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD) sent as cv_file_base64 plus cv_filename; the ad can be pasted text or a job_url the tool fetches and reduces to text. Returns a grade and score with matched evidence quoted from the CV, an honest gap list, a tailored CV built only from facts in the CV, an auditable change log, a cover note, five likely interview questions, ATS keywords split into present and missing, the exact texts that were analyzed (cv_text_used, job_text_used), and extraction metadata for both sides (cv_meta, job_meta).

cv_text.description: The user's CV or resume, pasted as plain text. Takes precedence over cv_file_base64.

cv_file_base64.description: Base64-encoded CV file (PDF, DOCX, TXT, or MD), at most 3 MB after decoding. Used only when cv_text is empty.

cv_filename.description: Original name of the uploaded CV file; its extension selects the text extractor.

cv_source.description: Where the CV came from, when the caller knows: a saved CV passed as cv_text should be marked saved. Defaults to paste for cv_text and file for cv_file_base64.

job_text.description: One job ad, pasted as plain text. Takes precedence over fetching job_url.

job_url.description: URL of the job ad. When job_text is empty, the tool fetches this page and extracts the ad text; when job_text is present, the URL is recorded and echoed only.

scenario.description: Framing preset for tone and interview focus. When omitted, the tool picks one from the ad text (internship and student wording, startup wording, otherwise corporate).

language.description: Language of the analysis: English or Indonesian. When omitted, the tool detects it from the texts.
